image_title: Infosys Consolidated Financial Data - Third Quarter, Fiscal 2026
summary: This document presents the consolidated financial data for Infosys for the third quarter of fiscal 2026. The Effort & Utilization section shows percentages for onsite (Dec 31, 2025: 23.1%, Sep 30, 2025: 23.2%, Dec 31, 2024: 24.0%) and offshore (Dec 31, 2025: 76.9%, Sep 30, 2025: 76.8%, Dec 31, 2024: 76.0%). Utilization rates are detailed as including trainees (Dec 31, 2025: 80.0%, Sep 30, 2025: 82.2%, Dec 31, 2024: 83.4%) and excluding trainees (Dec 31, 2025: 84.1%, Sep 30, 2025: 85.1%, Dec 31, 2024: 86.0%). Employee Metrics indicate total employees (Dec 31, 2025: 337,034, Sep 30, 2025: 331,991, Dec 31, 2024: 323,379), software professionals (Dec 31, 2025: 319,364, Sep 30, 2025: 314,500, Dec 31, 2024: 306,528), and voluntary attrition percentages (Dec 31, 2025: 12.3%, Sep 30, 2025: 14.3%, Dec 31, 2024: 13.7%). Cash Metrics include free cash flow (FCF) in millions (Dec 31, 2025: 915, Sep 30, 2025: 1,101, Dec 31, 2024: 1,263), adjustments for labor codes, and consolidated cash and investments (Dec 31, 2025: 3,917 million, Sep 30, 2025: 6,173 million, Dec 31, 2024: 4,653 million). The document provides a comprehensive overview of the company's financial performance and metrics.
